items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; evidence_needed for fleet-wide compliance/security clearance; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not public/commercial redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, trademark, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict relevant collection and derivative use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow, revenue contains $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable, and security/operations evidence is incomplete. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: do not launch, monetize, expand alerts, send rights outreach, or make security-sensitive releases until the gates are satisfied.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed; 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task can close because direct evidence for field rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident/request inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Their concrete blockers are incomplete ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Do not block ordinary growth merely because telemetry is incomplete. Existing reversible work may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, unapproved monetization, or unsupported claims. Preserve aggregate Amazon earnings as unattributed and unavailable cost, margin, ROI, forecast, payback, and causal-lift fields as unknown.
